examples.zh: 上唇

examples.en: Around the world, governments have subsidized the housing of middle- and upper-income groups.
examples.zh: 全世界各政府都补贴过中高收入人群的住房。

examples.en: Some earlier witness reports cited by police or security officials had explosives being thrown from a motorbike or the upper storey's of an adjacent hotel.
examples.zh: 一些更早的证词报道引用警方或安全部门的话说，爆炸物从摩托车上扔下，或是从领进旅馆的楼上扔下来。

examples.en: Katie was still awake, sitting bolt upright(= sitting with her back very straight ) staring at the television.
examples.zh: 凯蒂还醒着，坐得笔直，眼睛盯着电视。

phrases.translation: n. 肠胃不适，消化不良

examples.en: He upset a bowl of soup.
examples.zh: 他打翻了一碗汤。

examples.en: Don't do anything that would upset him.
examples.zh: 别做惹他生气的事情。

examples.en: Markets are very sensitive to any upsets in the Japanese economic machine.
examples.zh: 市场对日本经济机器里的任何混乱都是非常敏感的。

translations: 在楼上，向楼上；上楼；往楼上

examples.en: I went upstairs and had a shower.
examples.zh: 我上楼冲了个澡。

examples.en: She's upstairs in bed feeling ill.
examples.zh: 她身体不舒服，在楼上躺着。

examples.en: Marsani moved into the upstairs apartment.
examples.zh: 玛萨妮搬进了楼上的公寓。

phrases.translation: 上压力；向上压力；反向压力

examples.en: upward pressure on bank interest rates
examples.zh: 针对银行利率的越来越大的压力

examples.en: They climbed upward along the steep cliffs surrounding the village.
examples.zh: 他们沿着环绕村庄的陡峭悬崖向上爬。

examples.en: 'There,' said Jack, pointing upwards.
examples.zh: “那儿，”杰克往上指着说。

examples.en: The balloon floated upwards.
examples.zh: 气球向上飘去。

translations: (Urban)人名；(西)乌尔万；(斯洛伐)乌尔班；(德、俄、罗、匈、塞、波、捷、瑞典、意)乌尔班；(英)厄本；(法)于尔邦

examples.en: unemployment in urban areas
examples.zh: 城市地区的失业状况

examples.en: the deprived sections of the urban population
examples.zh: 城市人口中的贫困群体

examples.en: urban riots
examples.zh: 城市骚乱

translations: 强烈的欲望，迫切要求；推动力

examples.en: The charity urged quick action.
examples.zh: 慈善机构敦促迅速采取行动。

examples.en: When every molecule in your body tells you to run away from the burning building, as a firefighter you have to resist the urge, override it and plunge in.
examples.zh: 当你身体内每个细胞都告诉逃离失火的建筑物时，作为一名消防员，你必须克制这种冲动，超越它，投入火场进行战斗。

examples.en: She fought back the sudden urge to run to him and beg his forgiveness.
examples.zh: 她突然很想冲上去请求他原谅，但是她忍住了。

examples.en: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
examples.zh: 他急需治疗。

examples.en: The report called for urgent action to reduce lead in petrol.
examples.zh: 报告呼吁迅速采取行动，减少汽油中的铅含量。

examples.en: an urgent message
examples.zh: 一封急报

examples.en: She gave us a gift.
examples.zh: 她给了我们一份礼物。

phrases.translation: 使用时间；通信传输时间

examples.en: a book on modern English usage
examples.zh: 关于现代英语用法的书

phrases.translation: 土地利用，土地用途；土地使用，土壤使用

examples.en: an exit for use in emergencies
examples.zh: 紧急出口

examples.en: The yacht was intended for the King's own personal use.
examples.zh: 这艘游艇是专供国王私用的。

examples.en: This chapter discusses power, and how people use it.
examples.zh: 这一章节讲权力，以及人们如何运用权力。

translations: 习惯的；二手的，使用过的
用（use的过去式）；（used to）过去常做

examples.en: I do the dishes every day, so I'm used to it.
examples.zh: 我每天洗盘子，所以习惯了。

examples.en: Moira slammed on the brakes (=  used them suddenly and with a lot of force  ) .
examples.zh: 莫伊拉猛踩刹车。

examples.en: The water in Lake Powell is used to irrigate the area.
examples.zh: 包尔湖的水被用来灌溉该地区。

translations: 有用的，有益的；有帮助的

examples.en: useful information
examples.zh: 有用的信息

examples.en: A little Japanese can be really useful.
examples.zh: 懂一点日语非常有用。

examples.en: Can you come and make yourself useful(= help people to do something )?
examples.zh: 你能不能过来帮点忙？

examples.en: The editor killed a few useless lines.
examples.zh: 编辑删掉了几行无用的文字。

examples.en: Please cancel the words which are useless.
examples.zh: 请把无用的词划掉。

examples.en: They wrote his suggestion off as a useless idea.
examples.zh: 他们把他的建议看做是无用的想法。

examples.en: road users
examples.zh: 道路使用者

examples.en: a computer user
examples.zh: 电脑用户

examples.en: library users
examples.zh: 图书馆的读者

examples.en: Make a cheese sauce in the usual way.
examples.zh: 按通常的做法做奶酪酱。

examples.en: I'll meet you at the usual time.
examples.zh: 我在老时间和你碰头。

examples.en: She ate twice as much as usual.
examples.zh: 她吃了平时食量两倍的东西。

examples.en: Women usually live longer than men.
examples.zh: 女人通常比男人长寿。

examples.en: Usually I wear black, grey, or brown.
examples.zh: 通常我都穿黑色、灰色或者棕色的衣服。

examples.en: The drive usually takes 15 or 20 minutes.
examples.zh: 这段车程通常需要 15 或 20 分钟。

phrases.translation: 实用新型（约十个国家法律承认的一种保护发明名称，期限五年）
公用设施；公用事业公司

examples.en: Does your rent include utilities?
examples.zh: 你的房租包括公用事业费吗？

examples.en: It's a simple shareware utility that allows you to print signs and banners.
examples.zh: 这是个简单的共享应用软件，你可以用它来打印标牌和横幅。

examples.en: AOP does not replace existing programming paradigms and languages; instead, it works with them to improve their expressiveness and utility.
examples.zh: AOP并不 替换现存的程序范例或语言，而是 与 它们协同工作以提高他们的表达能力与效用。

examples.en: We must consider how best to utilize what resources we have.
examples.zh: 我们必须考虑怎样充分利用现有的资源。

examples.en: It is a matter of the utmost urgency to find out what has happened to these people.
examples.zh: 当务之急是弄清楚这些人出了什么事。

examples.en: Security matters are treated with the utmost seriousness.
examples.zh: 安全问题受到极为严肃的对待。

examples.en: That's utter nonsense!
examples.zh: 真是一派胡言！

examples.en: This company treats its employees with utter contempt.
examples.zh: 这家公司对其员工不屑一顾。

examples.en: I watched in complete and utter horror as he pulled out a gun.
examples.zh: 我惊恐万分地看着他拔出枪来。
